notes.title: Update: New option, levels, obstacle and MacOS X support
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29391106/a71264af3bdbeb03351c4660562487f506e6c6d7.png[/img]

1. New operating system support - MacOS X
2. In the options menu now you can choose to run/walk by default, as requested by MrMEOLA in this video at 3:45(btw, thanks MrMEOLA, I really like your videos :) )
https://youtu.be/TyYPn5n_GIM
3. New obstacle, trampoline
4. 3 new levels
